scripts.firebase:deploy:rules: set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --only firestore:rules
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.rules:dry-run-claims-only: npm run rules:build-claims-only && set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --config firebase.claims-only.json --only firestore:rules --project %FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID% --dry-run --non-interactive
scripts.test:rules:claims-only: npm run rules:build-claims-only && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-firestore-rules-tests.ps1 firestore.claims-only.rules firebase.claims-only.json
